answer_sentences.text: No. As of 15 March 2024, RBI had already issued an extension of the implementation timeline for the penal-charges instructions, so they were not yet in force for fresh loans by that date.
answer_sentences.quote: RBI/2023-24/102 DoR.MCS.REC.61/01.01.001/2023-24 December 29, 2023 ... Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts: Extension of Timeline for Implementation of Instructions Reference is invited to RBI circular DoR.MCS.REC.28/01.01.001/2023-24 dated August 18, 2023 on ‘Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts’.
